paired_statistical_oracle.resampling_index_algorithm: For endpoint ordinal e, replicate b and draw d, form SHA-256 of ASCII 'ht-paired-bootstrap-v5\0' || uint64be(seed) || uint32be(e) || uint32be(b) || uint32be(d) || uint32be(retry). Interpret the first 8 digest bytes as unsigned u. Let limit=floor(2^64/N)*N; increment retry from zero until u<limit; index=u mod N.
paired_statistical_oracle.paired_rule: Use one index vector per endpoint replicate for both q32 and relbias. Never drop, impute or independently resample an arm. Any replicate with an undefined registered statistic fails the gate.
paired_statistical_oracle.raw_p: Directional add-one sign probability: (1 + count(delta_bootstrap <= 0)) / 10001, computed as exact rational.
paired_statistical_oracle.holm: Sort raw p ascending, ties by family_order_for_ties. At sorted rank i in {1,2}, adjusted_p_i=max over j<=i of min(1,(2-j+1)*p_j). Map adjusted values back to endpoint names. Both adjusted p values must be <=0.05.
paired_statistical_oracle.holm_ci: At sorted rank i use alpha_i=0.05/(2-i+1). Produce a two-sided percentile interval with lower tail alpha_i/2 and upper tail alpha_i/2. For sorted B=10000 values, quantile(q) is nearest-rank value at zero-based index max(0,ceil(q*B)-1). The primary rollout lower bound must be >0; every registered family endpoint lower bound must be >0.
paired_statistical_oracle.primary_gate: rollout relbias-minus-q32 predicted_edge_f1 point delta >=0.01, its Holm-rank CI lower >0, its adjusted p <=0.05, the registered teacher endpoint passes the same directional CI/p gate, and every structural, teacher, secondary, efficiency and resource guard passes.
paired_statistical_oracle.structural_guards: For both arms and both modes: tree_valid, reconstruction_valid, leaf_retained and p4_valid true for every event; fallback total zero; all registered values finite; predicted-edge denominator positive.
paired_statistical_oracle.authority_dependency: A02-A04 are compiled only by this sealed reviewed v6 transition and must equal compiled_authority projections and hashes exactly. Bundle/runtime/fixture authority overrides are forbidden. Calculations may run on normative fixtures, but architecture_decision remains blocked by downstream_fail_closed_gates until all applicable feasibility/recovery artifacts and later authorizations are complete.
